translations.web: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.
translations.bsb: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD is their inheritance, as he hath said
translations.asv: And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren: Jehovah is their inheritance, as he hath spoken unto them.
